assessment.proposed_role: Architectural context recognition for later pipe and duct tracing research.
assessment.expected_benefit_hypothesis: Wall and room predictions may reduce mechanical trace proposals that follow architectural linework.
proposed_experiment: After rights and annotation review, train wall/room recognition as an auxiliary task or pretraining stage.
Use task-specific labels for mechanical training; treat missing pipe/duct annotations as unknown unless their absence is independently verified.
Supply architectural predictions as uncertain context while preserving original pixels and overlapping pipe/duct trace proposals.
Compare mechanical tracing with and without this context on the same held-out projects, keeping related sheets, crops and revisions in one split.
evaluation_focus: False pipe/duct traces following walls or other architectural features
Missed pipe/duct segments and broken connectivity at wall crossings
Trace localization and centerline accuracy against adjudicated mechanical annotations
assessment.next_action: Confirm dataset license and original source; audit source grouping and annotation coverage before selecting an exact version for an auxiliary-context experiment.
